recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i composeApp/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleFossRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT=composeApp/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/RiPlay-foss-release-*.apk
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 16 fix-newlines $OUT 'res/*.html' 'assets/composeResources/riplay.composeapp.generated.resources/drawable/*.xml' 'res/Xy.json' 'res/lM.json'
mv $OUT /outputs/unsigned.apk
